methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Olympian Motors is a Seed-stage transportation company founded by Eren Canarslan and Jasmine Sungu that has raised $9.6M to date. The transportation sector includes six identified private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, EarthGrid) and no listed public comparables. The narrow peer set at the Seed stage in transportation limits the applicability of conventional peer-median approaches.

A single valuation method was applicable to this analysis: Stage-Progression. Using the $9.6M total capital raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $24M. This method reflects the expected capital structure progression at this early stage but does not incorporate sector-specific growth dynamics or operational milestones.

The Peer-Median approach was inapplicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints at the same or adjacent stage within the transportation sector; a broad sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of the comp universe. The analysis supports a valuation range of $20M (low) to $28M (high), with a median estimate of $24M. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly-staged comparables, which limits confidence in stage-based multipliers, and the absence of revenue, capital efficiency, or technical validation metrics in the dataset.
